# canton_user (Resource)

Manages a user on a Canton participant node. Both `user_id` and `primary_party` are immutable — changing either forces replacement.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "canton_party" "treasury" {
  party_id_hint = "treasury"
}

resource "canton_user" "treasury_service" {
  user_id       = "treasury-service"
  primary_party = canton_party.treasury.party_id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `primary_party` (String) The primary party for the user.
- `user_id` (String) The user identifier.

## Import

Users can be imported by their user ID:

```shell
terraform import canton_user.treasury_service treasury-service
```
